description: Test suite for language hint filtering and normalization functions in a diff viewer context.

methods.name: filterSupportedLanguageHints
methods.description: Filters and validates a list of language hints, retaining only supported ones, defaulting to 'text' for invalid hints.

methods.name: normalizeDiffViewerPayloadLanguages
methods.description: Normalizes and downgrades language hints within a diff payload, ensuring valid language hints are respected and fallback to 'text' occurs when necessary.
